payload.text: The final-head gate (vc's decision 38, 19 Oct): tmp/dc-2141/gate/final-head-gate.sh <phase> <sha>, banked with its resume notes in ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-dc/gate/ (GATE-RESUME.md). Run at the exact sha vc names once utilz-cc's 0089 and 0092 have landed, the last two. Each phase is its own START, in order: kovacs (test-linux and its roster loop from the sha's own tests.yml, shellcheck 0.9.0, rust ubuntu build and test; Ubuntu acceptance unproven by name; this is what todo 5 was); mac-lint (fmt and clippy -D warnings on the Mac, vc's ruling); mac-suites (test-macos, bash 3.2 and 5, in a scratch clone); mac-rust (the crate's build, test and black-box suites); prez-at27 (video.sh --strict AT27 alone on a quiet host); menuz-app (utilz-ic's, heavy); report (one line per tests.yml job); then todo 3's dry run under vc's freeze of every node, refused unless the primary is clean. Size L.
